units: Defines formal measurement primitives for Adaptive Inheritance.
Measurement chain: E* -> LBR -> Phi_R(e_t) -> Delta W -> W_{t+1}.
AIC repeats that empirical contradiction should reduce at least one invalid mechanism's authority.
AIC does not require immediate replacement, zero future usage, or perfect confidence calibration.
High LBR is friction rather than attribution and may reflect exploration, mechanism failure, representation saturation, or generator decoupling.
Phi_R maps residual to simplex vector over N/S/M/R/G; dominant discrete layer is argmax.
Weight changes are proposed proportional to attribution mass: Delta w_i proportional to a_i.
Gamma_hat_B(R,e_t) is defined as minimum expected residual among mechanisms searched under budget B.
Low compressible residual implies current representation remains adequate; residual near baseline makes representation failure plausible.
REE=1 iff representation saturation and expected future gain exceeds representation cost; otherwise 0.
Healthy adaptation is associated with ARR toward 0; inheritance failure with ARR toward 1.
Authority half-life is minimum t at which invalid authority falls to at most half its initial value.
D(M1,M2) is proposed to measure actual structural mechanism change and reject superficial renaming as adaptation.
Correction velocity is structural distance divided by prediction contradiction magnitude.
Adaptive response latency equals correction time minus violation time.
ADI=LBR*C_post*(1-R_update), intended to increase with contradiction, confidence retention, and lack of structural update.
Source asserts metric dependency flow reality shift -> LBR -> Phi_R -> adaptation branch -> ARR -> latency/correction velocity -> ACS.
Every implementation is required to expose a MetricReport containing LBR, attribution vector, gamma_hat_B, ARR, authority half-life, structural distance, V_corr, tau_adapt, ADI, and ACS.
The source defines Gamma_hat_B mathematically but does not specify the actual mechanism-search space, estimator, sample procedure, or uncertainty.
Approximate equality to residual, B_max, expected future gain, and representation cost have no operational thresholds/estimators here.
The stated [0,1] range presumes authority cannot increase or become negative; the metric definition does not independently establish those conditions.
No concrete domain-general structural distance D or threshold theta is specified.
The probability interpretation of R_update lacks a sampling/estimation protocol.
Units and comparability of structural distance versus prediction-error norm are unspecified.
ADI's multiplicative components are not shown to be calibrated or jointly meaningful as a construct.
ACS aggregation and latency scaling are proposed without construct-validation or uncertainty protocol.
